<infobox theme="Media">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Publication information</header>
        <data source="publisher"><label>Publisher</label></data>	
        <data source="start date"><label>Start date</label></data>
        <data source="end date"><label>End date</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>	
        <data source="genre"><label>Genre(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="issues"><label><nowiki>#</nowiki> of issues</label></data>	
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:MagazineSeries|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
